key_insight: An AI-assisted evaluation pipeline improves assessment of research-level mathematical proofs across natural language, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
engineering_relevance: Multi-format proof evaluation offers a methodology for scaling mathematical validation in AI-for-science workflows.
method: Analyze Ramanujan Challenge submissions on research-level number theory problems.
Compare outcomes across AI models, computer algebra systems, and formal tools.
Assess semantic and logical correctness across proof formats using an AI-assisted pipeline.
evidence_signal: Compared with one-shot LLM judgment, the pipeline reduced natural-language proof false positives from 23% to 6% and increased supporting-code judgment accuracy from 46% to 58%.
watch_item: Residual evaluation errors remain, and the abstract does not establish generalization beyond the Challenge submissions.
paper_title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
